name: medusa-commerce
description: Let Grok Bot manage a Medusa v2 store as an agent. Golden Rule: read the official Medusa docs before any action (built-in medusa_docs tool). Fail-loud health, read-only catalog, inventory and PII-minimal orders, draft-only products by default, and opt-in publishing (MEDUSA_ALLOW_PUBLISH plus confirm=true). Includes an mcloud CLI setup.
